name: Adaptive Supersampling
definition: A technique to maintain a user-specified 3D sampling rate in perspective volume rendering by recursively splitting rays when the projected pixel area exceeds the square of the linear sampling rate, avoiding the wasted computation of uniform oversampling near the eye.
summary: Adaptive supersampling is a volume rendering technique that recursively splits rays when projected pixel area exceeds a threshold, avoiding wasted computation on near-eye voxels unlike uniform supersampling.
